title: qPCR assay to measure ISG expression in human cells
protocol: Remove medium completely from cells.
Wash cells carefully with 8 ml of 1xPBS; remove PBS completely.
Add 8 ml of 1xTrypsin to the cells, ensuring complete coverage of the plate.
Incubate cells at 37°C until they detach completely.
Add 12 ml of medium to the cells, resuspend and collect them in a 15 ml or 50 ml Falcon tube based on the number of EPOs required.
Count cells and aliquot 5x10^6 cells per EPO.
Spin cells down at 125 g for 5 minutes.
Wash pellet once with 5 ml of electroporation buffer.
Remove buffer from the cell pellet.
Add approximately 50% of the final volume of electroporation buffer to the cells (aim for a final volume of 100 µl).
Prepare a separate tube containing a mix of Renilla and pBluescript plasmids at a ratio of 1:10 to reach a total of 20 µg, with 2 µg of Renilla and 18 µg of pBluescript.
Resuspend the cells and add them to the plasmid DNA mix carefully without introducing air bubbles.
Do not add DNA to control samples.
Measure volume of cells after addition of plasmid DNA, fill up with EPO buffer to a total of 100 µl.
Add 100 µl of cell suspension into a 1x OC100 MaxCyte cuvette and use default settings for electroporation or optimization protocols as needed.
Transfer the 100 µl of cell suspension immediately to a pre-warmed 1x75 flask without adding medium.
Incubate cells at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Add an appropriate amount of pre-warmed medium without antibiotics to the cells, resuspend and plate at 1x10^6 cells per well in a pre-warmed 6-well plate.
Harvest cells 6 hours after addition of media.
For each well, harvest the medium of the cells (20% of cells are still not fully attached).
Wash once with 1 ml PBS and harvest PBS.
Add 1 ml of trypsin and incubate at 37°C until cells fully detach.
Add 1 ml of pre-warmed medium to detached cells.
Harvest cell suspension.
Spin the cells down at 125g for 5 minutes, remove supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 1 ml PBS.
Spin down cells at 125g/5min and remove supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 350 µl RLT + 1% β-Mercaptoethanol.
Transfer lysate to Qiashredder column, spin for 2 min at max speed.
Discard column, mix flow through with 1 volume 70% ethanol by pipetting.
Transfer max 700 µl lysate to RNeasy mini column, spin for 30s at 10,000g.
Discard flow through.
Wash column with 700 µl RW1, discard flow through.
Wash column with 500 µl RPE, discard flow through.
Wash column with 500 µl RPE, spin for 2 min at 10,000g.
Place column into new collection tube, spin for 1 min at full speed.
Elute into new 1.5ml tube with 50 µl RNase free H2O.
Add 2 µg RNA sample to a RNase-free tube on ice.
Add 2 µl Ambion buffer DNAse I to the tube on ice.
Add 2 µl Ambion rDNase I to the tube on ice.
Fill up with water to 20 µl in the tube on ice.
Incubate tube(s) for 30min at 37ºC.
Inactivate DNase I by adding 2 µl of inactivation solution, mix well before use.
Incubate for 2min at RT, vortex occasionally.
Centrifuge at 10,000xg for 5min and transfer 10 µl of the RNA into a fresh tube.
Transfer remaining 10 µl to a separate tube as negative –RT control.
Add 1 µl Oligo dT20 (50µM) to DNaseI treated RNA in master mix.
Add 1 µl dNTPs (10 mM each) to DNaseI treated RNA in master mix.
Add 4 µl 5X First-Strand Buffer (in the Superscript kit) to DNaseI treated RNA in master mix.
Add 1 µl of 0.1 M DTT from the Superscript kit.
Add 1 µl RNase Inhibitor Murine (Cat No. M0314S).
Add 1 µl SuperScript III RT (SuperScript® III Cat No. 18080044).
Add 1 µl H2O and mix by gently pipetting up and down.
Incubate the RT reaction at 25ºC for 5 min.
Incubate the RT reaction at 50ºC for 50 min.
Incubate the RT reaction at 70ºC for 15 min.
Bring the RT reaction volume to 100 µl by adding 80µl H2O.
Prepare a qPCR reaction setup with 10 µl of GoTag SYBR Green Master Mix (Promega; Cat No. A6001).
Add 1 µl primer mix (10 µM each) to the reaction mixture.
Add 2 µl cDNA to the reaction mixture.
Add 7 µl H2O to complete the reaction volume.
Distribute 18 µl of master mix into wells.
Seal the plate after adding 2 µl cDNA and vortexing.
Spin down the sealed plate to ensure proper mixing.
Pipette each sample per primer pair in triplicate for analysis.
Normalize Ct values for each target gene to a housekeeping gene using the delta Ct method.
Calculate delta delta Ct values between conditions (e.g., with or without DNA electroporation).
